The '''Battle of Scyva''' was fought in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] by the [[Eternal Empire]]<ref name="Codex" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Zakuul}}</ref> some [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> The [[Knights of Zakuul]], the Empire's order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors, participated in the battle, which shared its name with the [[Zakuulan]] [[God/Legends|god]] [[Scyva]]. Two Knights&mdash;the [[Indo Zal's mother|mother]] and [[Indo Zal's father|father]] of a young boy named [[Indo Zal]]&mdash;were killed in the battle, leaving Indo to be raised by his sister [[Kalya Zal|Kalya]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Scyva was mentioned in the Codex entry for Indo Zal in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']],<ref name="Codex" /> the [[2016]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Launch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161202-1|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Now Live!}}</ref>
